meta.title: Directive 8020 — Shoot Williams or Stand Down? Best Choice & Consequences
meta.description: Directive 8020 Episode 5: Stand Down is best if you prepared the sedative — Williams survives and you unlock the Sedate Williams trophy. Without it, shoot instead.
meta.ogTitle: Directive 8020 — Shoot Williams or Stand Down? Best Choice & Consequences
meta.ogDescription: Episode 5 Point Blank choice explained: Stand Down with the sedative, Shoot without it. Full consequences for both options.

hero.tagline: Stand Down — if you prepared the sedative. Shoot — if you didn't.
hero.intro: The Episode 5 “Point Blank” choice, fully broken down: what each option does, what it locks, and what it unlocks.

options.heading: The Three Options at Point Blank

cards.title: Stand Down — hold fire
cards.body: Buys time. If you prepared the sedative in the lab, it becomes available here and Williams can be neutralized non-lethally.
cards.chain: ⟳ Cross-episode: Stand Down + sedative = Williams lives → helpful Ep7 intel → better Ep8 dynamics. Required for the Sedate Williams trophy.

cards.title: Shoot immediately
cards.body: The Williams duplicate is eliminated on the spot. Clean and fast — but you lose the optional trophy.
cards.chain: ⟳ Cross-episode: Shoot = Williams dies → loses Ep7 intel → one Ep7 dialogue check harder. Sedate Williams trophy locked.

cards.title: Time Out — wait and see
cards.body: A minor delay with the same outcomes as Stand Down.

sceneContext.heading: What Leads Up to This Choice?
sceneContext.summary: ⚠ Spoilers — click to expand the scene context
paragraphs: Williams is scanned by the ship's biometric system during Episode 5 (“Mr. Williams”). The result is immediate and damning: **“Subject unidentifiable.”** Before anyone can react, Williams begins to transform — skin shifting, form destabilizing. The mimicry breaks down under the scanner's beam, and you have seconds to respond.

This confrontation only goes well if you did your homework two scenes earlier. The **sedative** is the single most missable interaction in the game: while Eisele is in the science lab, you get roughly ninety seconds of free-roam control and no objective marker. Walk to the chemistry station — the counter with beakers and an active terminal on the left wall — and interact with it. Skip it and the sedative option never appears here.
One more chain from way back: choosing **“Authorize use of weapon”** in the Episode 1 Crew Quarters is what unlocks the non-lethal resolution branch in this standoff in the first place.

outcomes.heading: What Happens If You Pick Each Option

columns.heading: Stand Down →
items: With sedative: Williams is sedated non-lethally and survives
Williams provides helpful intel in Episode 7
Improves Episode 8 dynamics and feeds the best ending path
Without sedative: no non-lethal option — Williams must die or escape

columns.heading: Shoot →
items: The duplicate is eliminated immediately — no further threat
Episode 7 intel from Williams is lost
One Episode 7 dialogue check becomes harder

outcomes.outro: If you prepared the sedative, Stand Down is the better call — you neutralize the threat and keep Williams alive for trophy purposes. If you skipped the sedative, shooting is the safer option because you have no non-lethal alternative.

faqs.q: Should you shoot Williams or stand down in Directive 8020?
faqs.a: Stand Down is the best choice if you prepared the sedative in the Episode 5 lab — Williams survives, you earn the Sedate Williams trophy, and his intel helps in Episodes 7 and 8. If you skipped the sedative, Shoot is the safer option.

faqs.q: What happens if you shoot Williams?
faqs.a: The duplicate is eliminated immediately. The Sedate Williams trophy is permanently locked, Williams's Ep7 intel is lost, and one Ep7 dialogue check becomes harder.

faqs.q: What happens if you stand down without the sedative?
faqs.a: Without the sedative there is no non-lethal option — Williams must die or escape. That's why preparing the sedative before leaving the science lab is the single most missable step in the game.

faqs.q: How do you save Williams in Directive 8020?
faqs.a: Prepare the sedative in the Episode 5 science lab, then choose Stand Down at Point Blank. With the sedative, Williams is neutralized non-lethally and survives — this also unlocks the Sedate Williams trophy.
